topTalentPage.title: Top Talent
topTalentPage.subtitle: The badge for the highest-ranked verified workers.
topTalentPage.whatItIsBody: Top Talent is a badge for the highest-ranked verified workers on Paid Talent. It is not a paid plan. Verified Pro lets recruiters message these profiles, with higher limits, inbox priority, and a longer opener with an opening attached. Contact details stay private until talent share them in chat.
topTalentPage.whoItsForBody: Venues and recruiters who want faster access to standout, verified talent — and workers who want to be discovered by serious hiring venues.
topTalentPage.howAccessBody: Top Talent badges and ranking stay visible to recruiters. Messaging Top Talent, higher contact-request limits, and inbox priority require a verified recruiter on Verified Pro (unless the platform is temporarily in open-access mode). LINE, WhatsApp, and phone are never shown on profiles.

accountDeletion.title: Delete my account
accountDeletion.body: Deleting your account suspends it immediately. We permanently remove the account after about 30 days. Deleting your account removes your chats after about 30 days. If a conversation was reported, an evidence copy of the reported messages is kept with the report for up to 2 years. Hiding a chat only hides it from your view and does not delete it.
accountDeletion.failed: Could not request deletion. Try again.
accountDeletion.dangerBody: Deleting your account suspends it immediately. After you confirm, you cannot undo it from the app.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This draft summarizes how Paid Talent intends to handle personal data. It is not final legal advice and will be updated before launch.
privacyPage.whoWeAreBody: TODO: Legal entity name, registered address, and contact details for the data controller.
privacyPage.dataCollectedBody: Account details (such as email and role), profile information, photos, optional private contact methods you save for later sharing in chat (LINE, WhatsApp, phone), job preferences, messages, contact requests, and reports. Recruiter verification includes a government ID image, a liveness video, and the venue links you submit. If you link LINE, we store your LINE user ID.
privacyPage.howWeUseBody: We use this data to operate the marketplace, verify workers and recruiters, show profiles to recruiters, process subscriptions and passes, prevent fraud and abuse, and improve the product. We screen messages for safety. Automated filters look for contact details and risk keywords before staff review a report or flag.
privacyPage.safetyReviewsBody: Authorised Paid Talent staff may read a conversation only when it has been reported or automatically flagged, and each access is logged.
privacyPage.retentionBody: Messages are kept for 180 days after a conversation's last activity. Hiding a chat only hides it from your view. Deleting your account removes your chats after about 30 days. If a conversation was reported, an evidence copy of the reported messages is kept with the report for up to 2 years. ID documents and liveness videos are deleted after review. The default retention period for that verification media is 30 days (RETENTION_DAYS).
privacyPage.notificationsBody: We send email alerts and, if you link LINE, optional LINE alerts about contact requests and messages. You can turn email or LINE alerts off in your notification settings. Unlinking LINE stops LINE alerts.
privacyPage.sharingBody: Recruiters never see your contact details. You choose to share them in chat. Recruiters are identity-verified. We share data with service providers that help us run hosting, storage, email, and payments. We do not sell personal data.
privacyPage.yourRightsBody: TODO: Describe applicable rights (access, correction, deletion, objection) and how to exercise them under relevant law. You can request account deletion from your profile settings.
privacyPage.contactBody: TODO: Privacy contact email and mailing address for data requests.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These draft terms outline intended rules for using Paid Talent. They are not final and will be reviewed before launch.
termsPage.acceptanceBody: By creating an account or using Paid Talent, you agree to these terms and our Privacy Policy once they are finalized.
termsPage.eligibilityBody: You must be 20 years of age or older to use Paid Talent. Accounts may require age and identity verification.
termsPage.accountsBody: You are responsible for activity on your account. Workers and recruiters have different features; misuse, impersonation, or fake verification may lead to suspension or bans.
termsPage.recruiterObligationsBody: Recruiters must not charge talent fees or deposits, must not keep copies of identity documents, and must not use Paid Talent to recruit people for work outside Thailand. TODO: Legal entity name, registered address, and contact email.
termsPage.marketplaceBody: Paid Talent helps venues discover talent. Hiring decisions, pay, and work arrangements happen directly between users. Do not post unlawful, harmful, or misleading content.
termsPage.subscriptionsBody: Verified Pro is a monthly or annual subscription, or a 7-day pass. It lets a verified recruiter message workers who have the Top Talent badge, use higher contact-request limits, and appear with inbox priority. Paid Talent does not sell contact details. LINE, WhatsApp, and phone stay private until talent choose to share them in chat.
termsPage.reportingBody: Anyone can report a contact request or conversation. Paid Talent may pause a recruiter's messaging automatically when reports reach the safety threshold. Staff review reports and automatic flags.
termsPage.liabilityBody: TODO: Finalize limitation of liability, disclaimer, and governing-law language with counsel.
termsPage.contactBody: TODO: Legal entity name and contact email for terms questions.
